'''Terraton''' is a [[Rock]] type [[Guardian]] [[Tatari]]. It evolves from [[Rockshell]] at 6 silver moons after completing their specific [[trials|evolution trials]].

==Overview==
Current Description: "The rock on Terraton's back resembles a small hill, offering a resting place for small Tatari. Ask for a quick ride, and you won't be turned down."

Terraton is a rainbow rarity Tatari. Like all Tier 4 evolutions, it requires B Rating to acquire, therefore its feeding level cannot be below B rating for each stat. 

==Appearance==
A large, spikey tortoise, vaguely resembling a snapping turtle. Its front legs are much larger and more prominent than its back legs, and its shell takes up most of its frame. It has orange eyes, a dark brown shell, a brown body, and white accents. 

Terraton's [[Tatari#Glitter_Tataris|Glitter]] form replaces its brown body with orange, and its brown shell becomes turquoise green. Its eyes and claws also become turquoise green.

==Strategy==
[[File:Terraton Attack Range.png|x200px|left|thumb|Terraton's attack range]]
Terraton is a strong Rock tank, and has the longest range of any Rock tank. This makes it a key critter when taking down ranged [[Lightning]] types such as Nurse [[Zobos]]. Its shield ability also lets it sit behind another tank, acting as a DPS and support along with its tankiness. 
{{clear|left}}

==Trivia==
* Terraton's design is inspired by a snapping turtle.
* Prior to the update on 3/11/2026, its bio description said: "As expected from a fourth-stage evolution, the Terraton's colors and patterns are even more refined than the [[Rockshell]]'s!"
* Prior to the update on 5/13/26 its bio description said: "The rock on Terraton's back resembles a small hill, offering a resting place for some Tatari or a ride for others."
